# dnax.ui

> dnax.ui is a Vue 3 design system with a Quasar-style public API — `<q-btn flat dense no-caps>`, boolean modifier props, `v-model` conventions, kebab-case tags — built on shadcn-vue techniques (cva, `cn()`, tailwind-merge, CSS token theming, Iconify icons). This file indexes the documentation site so an LLM can navigate every component, plugin, directive and guide. All pages are written in English.

## About the docs

Each component page follows the same structure: a short lead describing the component, a series of interactive demo sections (each with a Preview / Code tab, and a Script setup block when state is involved), then an **API** section rendered by `docs-api`, with tabs for **Props** (name, type, values, default, required), **Slots**, **Events** (with payloads) and **Methods**. Component props are written in kebab-case in templates and camelCase in TypeScript. Most components accept the shared modifiers `dense`, `outlined`, `bordered`, `flat`, `disable`, `readonly`, `dark`, `color`/`text-color`, `size` and a `label`.

The design system lives in `@dnax/ui` (npm package `@dnax/ui`, source in `packages/ui/`): every `Q*` component is exported from the package root and auto-registered by the Nuxt module as a kebab-case tag (e.g. `QBtn` → `<q-btn>`). Global styles and tokens are in `styles/main.css`. Plugins are used through the `$q` object (`$q.dialog`, `$q.notify`, `$q.loading`, `$q.imagePreview`, `$q.bottomSheet`, `$q.localStorage` / `$q.sessionStorage`).

## Layouts

- [Config Provider](/docs/components/config-provider) — the app root: theme (colors, mode, default component props, lang) + $q providers (dialog, notify, loading, bottom sheet, image preview).
- [Page Layout](/docs/components/page) — QPage — the content area, with optional virtual scroll and automatic padding under fixed bars (q-header / q-footer).
- [Header Layout](/docs/components/header)
- [Footer Layout](/docs/components/footer)
- [Sidebar Layout](/docs/components/sidebar) — QSidebar — a collapsible side navigation panel (shadcn Sidebar + QDrawer API).

## Components

- [Accordion](/docs/components/accordion) — QAccordion — collapsible sections (single or multiple open).
- [Action Sheet](/docs/components/action-sheet)
- [App](/docs/components/app) — QApp — the root app container: exposes <slot /> for the whole page shell.
- [Autocomplete](/docs/components/autocomplete)
- [Avatar](/docs/components/avatar)
- [Back Header](/docs/components/back-header)
- [Back Top](/docs/components/back-top)
- [Badge](/docs/components/badge)
- [Bar](/docs/components/bar) — QBar — a thin window/app bar (toolbar role): window buttons, menus, status; dense & dark variants.
- [Board](/docs/components/board) — QBoard — a Power BI-like dashboard: a background tile grid (columns × rows, optional labels) with QInteract inside for drag & resize of grid-unit tiles.
- [Bottom Sheet](/docs/components/bottom-sheet) — QBottomSheet — a sheet sliding from the bottom for contextual actions.
- [Breadcrumbs](/docs/components/breadcrumbs) — QBreadcrumbs / QBreadcrumbsEl — breadcrumb trail with automatic separators (text or Iconify icon), router/native links, active-color on the current (last) crumb. Emits `change` (index of the clicked crumb) when a non-current crumb is clicked.
- [Bubble](/docs/components/bubble) — QBubble — chat message bubbles aligned to start/end.
- [Button](/docs/components/btn) — QBtn — a button (native <button>/<a>) with Quasar API.
- [Button Actions](/docs/components/btn-actions) — QBtnActions — a dropdown button (QBtn + menu) driven by an `actions` array ({ label, value, icon, color, description, onClick }): emits `select-action` on click, behaves like a QBtnDropdown with the actions embedded. The teleported panel opens around the trigger with configurable `position` and `offset`.
- [Button Dropdown](/docs/components/btn-dropdown) — QBtnDropdown — a dropdown button (QBtn + caret) with `items` whose entries can carry a **left icon** and a **right icon** (`leftIcon`/`rightIcon`), plus color/description/separator: emits `select` on click. Panel placement around the trigger is set with `position` (bottom/top/left/right + start/end) and `offset`.
- [Button Group](/docs/components/btn-group) — QBtnGroup — groups buttons into a single visual unit.
- [Card](/docs/components/card) — QCard — a flexible content container.
- [Carousel](/docs/components/carousel) — QCarousel — a responsive item carousel with scroll-snap (Embla).
- [Checkbox](/docs/components/checkbox) — QCheckbox — a toggle with boolean / indeterminate / array model.
- [Chip](/docs/components/chip) — QChip — compact tag/filter/selection element.
- [Circular Progress](/docs/components/circular-progress) — QCircularProgress — an SVG ring progress with an optional centered value (size, color, toggleable).
- [Collapse](/docs/components/collapse)
- [Container](/docs/components/container)
- [Count Down](/docs/components/count-down)
- [Country Picker](/docs/components/country-picker)
- [Data Grid](/docs/components/data-grid) — QDataGrid — a spreadsheet-like data grid (MUI X style): keyboard selection, in-place editing and =formulas with A1 / range references.
- [Date Picker](/docs/components/date-picker)
- [Dialog](/docs/components/dialog) — QDialog — a modal overlay family (dialog, header, content, footer, trigger, provider).
- [Editor.js](/docs/components/editor-js) — QEditorJs — a block editor (Editor.js): JSON v-model, paragraph/header/list/checklist/quote/code/delimiter tools, SSR-safe.
- [Fab](/docs/components/fab)
- [File Picker](/docs/components/file-picker) — QFilePicker — file selection (hidden input) with typed icon, image thumbnail, name + size and validation.
- [Gallery](/docs/components/gallery)
- [Icon](/docs/components/icon)
- [Image](/docs/components/img)
- [Image Picker](/docs/components/image-picker) — QImagePicker — image selection via hidden file input with a grid preview (object URLs), tile removal and validation.
- [Image Preview](/docs/components/image-preview)
- [Image Preview Provider](/docs/components/image-preview-provider) — QImagePreviewProvider — renders the programmatic $q.imagePreview stack (auto-mounted by QConfigProvider).
- [Infinite Scroll](/docs/components/infinite-scroll)
- [Inner Loading](/docs/components/inner-loading)
- [Input](/docs/components/input) — QInput — a single-line text field (label, validation, icons, affixes).
- [Input OTP](/docs/components/input-otp)
- [Input Password](/docs/components/input-password)
- [Input Tag](/docs/components/input-tag)
- [Interact](/docs/components/interact) — QInteract — a container of draggable & resizable widgets (x/y/w/h) for building dashboards; optional collision, gap, grid, selection.
- [Intersection](/docs/components/intersection)
- [Linear Progress](/docs/components/linear-progress)
- [List](/docs/components/list) — QList / QItem / QItemSection — the list family (container, rows, sections).
- [Loading](/docs/components/loading)
- [Marquee](/docs/components/marquee)
- [Message Scroller](/docs/components/message-scroller) — QMessageScroller — keeps a chat transcript pinned to the live edge.
- [Nav Menu](/docs/components/nav-menu) — QNavMenu — a top navigation bar with dropdown menus (shadcn NavigationMenu).
- [Pagination](/docs/components/pagination)
- [Parallax](/docs/components/parallax)
- [Pull To Refresh](/docs/components/pull-to-refresh)
- [Radio](/docs/components/radio) — QRadio — a radio option for single-choice groups.
- [Rating](/docs/components/rating)
- [Reorder](/docs/components/reorder) — QReorder — a draggable list (mouse/touch/keyboard) to reorder items.
- [Rolling Text](/docs/components/rolling-text)
- [Safe Area](/docs/components/safe-area)
- [Scroll Area](/docs/components/scroll-area)
- [Select](/docs/components/select) — QSelect — a dropdown for single/multiple values (inline, modal, sheet).
- [Separator](/docs/components/separator)
- [Skeleton](/docs/components/skeleton)
- [Slider](/docs/components/slider) — QSlider — a draggable range input (pointer + keyboard).
- [Space](/docs/components/space) — QSpace — fills the remaining space in a flex container (pushes elements to the sides).
- [Spinner](/docs/components/spinner)
- [Splitter](/docs/components/splitter)
- [Spreadsheet](/docs/components/spreadsheet) — QSpreadsheet — an Excel-like grid: inline editing, typed cells (string/number/integer/email/url/date/datetime/boolean/select), A1 formulas + fx bar, keyboard navigation, autofill, filters, freeze panes, merge/hide, conditional formatting, validation, drag&drop reorder, virtual scroll, multi-sheets, JSON/CSV export, i18n (en/fr).
- [Sticky](/docs/components/sticky)
- [Swipe Cell](/docs/components/swipe-cell)
- [Swiper](/docs/components/swiper) — QSwiper — a full-featured carousel (swiper): slides-per-view, loop, navigation, autoplay, effects.
- [Syntax](/docs/components/syntax) — QSyntax — code blocks with Shiki syntax highlighting (client-side), filename bar, copy button.
- [Tab Panels](/docs/components/tab-panels)
- [Table](/docs/components/table) — QTable — tabular data with sorting, pagination, selection.
- [Tabs](/docs/components/tabs)
- [Text](/docs/components/text)
- [Text Caption](/docs/components/text-caption)
- [Tiptap](/docs/components/tiptap) — QTiptap — a rich text editor powered by Tiptap v3 (v-model HTML): full toolbar, text color, images by URL, align, font-size, task list, mentions, bubble menu, drag handle, tables, table of contents.
- [Toolbar](/docs/components/toolbar) — QToolbar — a horizontal action bar for headers/footers.
- [Tooltip](/docs/components/tooltip)
- [Uploader](/docs/components/uploader) — QUploader — a file upload zone (Vant-style): file list v-model, image thumbnails, progress and validation.
- [Video](/docs/components/video) — QVideo — a full-featured video player (Video.js): mp4/webm/HLS/YouTube with controls and skins.
- [Virtual Scroll](/docs/components/virtual-scroll) — QVirtualScroll — a windowed list renderer: only mounts the items near the visible area (with margins).

## Plugins API

- [Dialog](/docs/plugins/dialog) — $q.dialog: open a dialog imperatively from code (options, components, controller, useDialogPluginComponent).
- [Bottom Sheet](/docs/plugins/bottom-sheet) — $q.bottomSheet: open a bottom sheet imperatively from code (options, controller).
- [Notify](/docs/plugins/notify) — $q.notify: show toasts (position, type, timeout, actions).
- [Loading](/docs/plugins/loading) — $q.loading: show/hide a fullscreen or scoped loading overlay.
- [Image Preview](/docs/plugins/image-preview) — $q.imagePreview: open a fullscreen lightbox from code.
- [Platform](/docs/plugins/platform) — $q.platform: detect OS/browser/device (is.desktop, is.ios, is.mobile, has.touch…).
- [Web Storage](/docs/plugins/web-storage) — $q.localStorage / $q.sessionStorage: Quasar-compatible web storage (typed get/set, SSR-safe).

## Vue Directives

- [V Close](/docs/directives/close) — v-close: close the parent overlay (dialog / bottom sheet) on click.
- [V Touch Pan](/docs/directives/touch-pan) — v-touch-pan: pan gesture (Pointer Events), direction filters, delta, distance, speed.
- [V Touch Hold](/docs/directives/touch-hold) — v-touch-hold: press-and-hold gesture (duration, repeat, cancel on move).
- [V Touch Swipe](/docs/directives/touch-swipe) — v-touch-swipe: swipe direction detection (left/right/up/down).
- [V Touch Repeat](/docs/directives/touch-repeat) — v-touch-repeat: repeat a callback while held.
- [V Intersection](/docs/directives/intersection) — v-intersection: observe element visibility (one-shot/always, callbacks).
